This is a home for writing, projects, and notes: a place where longer thoughts and small discoveries can live together.

The interface borrows a little from a terminal. Follow ordinary links, press `:` to use the command line above, or press `s` to search this space. Try `ls`, `cd ~/projects`, or `ssh` to visit a friend.

> A quiet interface. Space for the things that matter.

## A site taking shape

The structure is ready; the personal story is still to come. The writing marked “Example content” demonstrates the reading experience and can be replaced with original posts.

Start with [what’s being built](/projects), browse the [writing](/blog), or take a look at the [tools behind this site](/uses).
